RISW short course example - graphicalMCP

Dong Xi

2026-06-03

library(graphicalMCP)

Example 3

Initial graph

hypotheses <- c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0)
transitions <- rbind(c(0, 0.5, 0.5, 0),
                     c(0.5, 0, 0, 0.5),
                     c(0, 1, 0, 0),
                     c(1, 0, 0, 0))
hyp_names <- c("H1", "H2", "H3", "H4")
g <- graph_create(hypotheses,
                  transitions,
                  hyp_names)
plot(g, vertex.size = 30, margins = c(1,1,1,1))

Updated graph

updated_g <- graph_update(g, delete = c(F, T, F, F))
plot(updated_g, vertex.size = 30, margins = c(1,1,1,1))

Testing

p_value <- c(0.018, 0.01, 0.105, 0.006)
test_results <- graph_test_shortcut(g, p = p_value, alpha = 0.025)
test_results$outputs$rejected
##    H1    H2    H3    H4 
##  TRUE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE
test_results$outputs$adjusted_p
##    H1    H2    H3    H4 
## 0.024 0.020 0.105 0.024

Stepwise decisions

test_results <- graph_test_shortcut(g, p = p_value, alpha = 0.025,test_values=T)
test_results$test_values$results
##   Step Hypothesis     p Weight Alpha Inequality_holds
## 1    1         H2 0.010   0.50 0.025             TRUE
## 2    2         H1 0.018   0.75 0.025             TRUE
## 3    3         H4 0.006   0.50 0.025             TRUE
## 4    4         H3 0.105   1.00 0.025            FALSE

Rejection sequences

graph_rejection_orderings(test_results)$valid_orderings
## [[1]]
## H2 H1 H4 
##  2  1  4 
## 
## [[2]]
## H2 H4 H1 
##  2  4  1

Power

set.seed(1234)
power_results <- graph_calculate_power(g,
                                       sim_n = 1e6,
                                       sim_corr = diag(4),
                                       power_marginal = c(0.9, 0.9, 0.8, 0.8))
power_results$power$power_local
##       H1       H2       H3       H4 
## 0.882505 0.883201 0.667549 0.668183

Success objectives

set.seed(1234)
success_fns <- list(# Prob to reject both hypotheses for either dose
  `(H1andH3)or(H2andH4)` = function(x) (x[1] & x[3]) | (x[2] & x[4]))
power_results <- graph_calculate_power(g,
                                       sim_n = 1e6,
                                       sim_corr = diag(4),
                                       power_marginal = c(0.9, 0.9, 0.8, 0.8),
                                       sim_success= success_fns)
power_results$power$power_success
## (H1andH3)or(H2andH4) 
##             0.831936

Example based on the CANTOS trial

Initial graph

hypotheses <- c(0.2, 0.4, 0.4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
epsilon <- 1e-5
transitions <- rbind(H11=c(0, 0.45, 0.25, 0.27, 0, 0, 0.03, 0, 0),
                     H21=c(0.07, 0, 0.63, 0, 0.27, 0, 0, 0.03, 0),
                     H31=c(0.07, 0.13, 0, 0, 0, 0.72, 0, 0, 0.08),
                     H12=c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0),
                     H22=c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0),
                     H32=c(0, epsilon, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1 - epsilon),
                     H13=c(0, epsilon, 0, 1 - epsilon, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                     H23=c(0, 0, epsilon, 0, 1 - epsilon, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                     H33=c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0))
g <- graph_create(hypotheses, transitions)
plot_layout <- rbind(c(0.15, 0.5), c(0.65, 0.5), c(1.15, 0.5),
                     c(0, 0), c(0.5, 0), c(1, 0),
                     c(0.3, 0), c(0.8, 0), c(1.3, 0))
plot(g,
     layout = plot_layout,
     eps = epsilon,
     edge_curves = c(pairs = 0.5),
     vertex.size = 15,
     rescale = FALSE,
     xlim = c(-0.2, 1.5),
     ylim = c(-0.3, 0.9))

Updated objectives

updated_g <- graph_update(g, delete = c(T, F, F, F, F, F, F, F, F))
  plot_layout <- rbind(
    c(0.15, 0.8), c(0.75, 0.8), c(1.35, 0.8),
    c(0, 0),      c(0.6, 0),    c(1.15, 0),
    c(0.3, 0),    c(0.9, 0),    c(1.5, 0)
  )
  plot(updated_g,
       layout = plot_layout,
       eps = epsilon,
       edge_curves = c(pairs = 0.3),
       vertex.size = 15,
       edge.label.cex = 0.7,
       rescale = FALSE,
       xlim = c(-0.2, 1.7),
       ylim = c(-0.3, 1.1))

Testing

set.seed(1234)
corr <- matrix(0.4, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
diag(corr) <- 1
pvalues <- c(0.0314, 0.02075, 0.30, 0.004, 0.005, 0.12, 0.006, 0.02, 0.07) / 2
test_results <- graph_test_closure(g,
                                   p = pvalues,
                                   alpha = 0.0245,
                                   test_groups= list(1:3, 4:9),
                                   test_types= c("parametric", "bonferroni"),
                                   test_corr= list(corr, NA))
test_results$outputs$rejected
##   H11   H21   H31   H12   H22   H32   H13   H23   H33 
## FALSE  TRUE FALSE FALSE  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
test_results$outputs$adjusted_p
##        H11        H21        H31        H12        H22        H32        H13 
## 0.06486779 0.02405970 0.15000000 0.06486779 0.02405955 0.15000000 0.06486779 
##        H23        H33 
## 0.06481180 0.15000000

Closed test

set.seed(1234)
closed_test <- graph_test_closure(g,
                                  p = pvalues,
                                  alpha = 0.0245,
                                  test_groups = list(1:3, 4:9),
                                  test_types = c("parametric", "bonferroni"),
                                  test_corr = list(corr, NA),
                                  test_values = TRUE)
subset(closed_test$test_values$results, Intersection == "011111111")
##      Intersection Hypothesis       Test        p      c_value Weight  Alpha
## 1281    011111111        H21 parametric 0.010375 1.0496628041  0.490 0.0245
## 1282    011111111        H31 parametric 0.150000 1.0496628041  0.450 0.0245
## 1283    011111111        H12 bonferroni 0.002000               0.054 0.0245
## 1284    011111111        H22 bonferroni 0.002500               0.000 0.0245
## 1285    011111111        H32 bonferroni 0.060000               0.000 0.0245
## 1286    011111111        H13 bonferroni 0.003000               0.006 0.0245
## 1287    011111111        H23 bonferroni 0.010000               0.000 0.0245
## 1288    011111111        H33 bonferroni 0.035000               0.000 0.0245
##      Inequality_holds
## 1281             TRUE
## 1282            FALSE
## 1283            FALSE
## 1284            FALSE
## 1285            FALSE
## 1286            FALSE
## 1287            FALSE
## 1288            FALSE

Power

set.seed(1234)
marginal_power <- c(0.85, 0.85, 0.85, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
corr_sim <-matrix(0.5, nrow = 9, ncol = 9)
diag(corr_sim) <- 1
success_fns <- list(`AllPE` = function(x) x[1] & x[2] & x[3])
power_results <- graph_calculate_power(g,
                                       alpha = 0.0245,
                                       sim_corr = corr_sim,
                                       sim_n = 1e5,
                                       power_marginal = c(marginal_power),
                                       test_groups= list(1:3, 4:9),
                                       test_types= c("parametric", "bonferroni"),
                                       test_corr= list(corr, NA),
                                       sim_success = success_fns)
power_results$power
## $power_local
##     H11     H21     H31     H12     H22     H32     H13     H23     H33 
## 0.71669 0.78408 0.80011 0.44954 0.52344 0.59923 0.34873 0.40960 0.47068 
## 
## $rejection_expected
## [1] 5.1021
## 
## $power_at_least_1
## [1] 0.91836
## 
## $power_all
## [1] 0.28256
## 
## $power_success
##   AllPE 
## 0.59244
